newsitem.title: USA: WCI Steel extends debt tender offer.
newsitem.headline: WCI Steel extends debt tender offer.

text.p: WCI Steel Inc said on Wednesday that it has extended its offer to purchase up to all of its outstanding 10-1/2 percent Senior Notes due 2002 to midnight November 22, 1996.
As of 1230 EST today, $111,885,000 in aggregate principal amount of the notes had been tendered, which represents a majority of the outstanding total principal amount, WCI said.
In addition, WCI Steel Holdings said that it has extended its offer to buy all of WCI Steel Inc's common stock to midnight November 26, 1996. As of today, 534,409 shares have been tendered.
WCI Steel Holdings is a wholly owned subsidiary of Renco, the holder of 84 percent of WCI Steel.
Renco previously announced plans to take WCI Steel private, buying WCI's common stock for $10 a share in the tender offer.
